purpose: Define the next-stage tool LP_BSC_10_20U_PROBE_DRY_RUN_BUILDER_V1 that produces a fully-reviewed unsigned-tx package for human approval. NO wallet, NO signer, NO transaction submission ever, even after approval — that is a further-future stage.

required_inputs.rpc_endpoint: from BSC_RPC_PRIMARY env var (must be paid endpoint; publicnode allowed for dry-run only)
required_inputs.wallet_address_for_simulation_only: checksummed address — used solely to set eth_call `from` field and to query balance via eth_call; NEVER loaded as a signer

unsigned_tx_package_contents.approve_tx_calldata: hex (constructed but NOT signed, NOT sent)
unsigned_tx_package_contents.mint_tx_calldata: hex (constructed but NOT signed, NOT sent)
unsigned_tx_package_contents.mint_tx_simulated_logs: from eth_call (look for NFT Transfer + IncreaseLiquidity)
unsigned_tx_package_contents.expected_tokenId_if_predictable: uint256 or null (PositionManager mints incremental IDs, often predictable read-only)

manual_approval_checkpoint.what_human_sees: the full unsigned tx package JSON + the dry_run_report MD + the risk_limits MD + this stage's review packet
manual_approval_checkpoint.what_human_must_type_to_approve: explicit phrase, e.g. 'I approve probe 0x172fcd41 USDT/WBNB 20U 15m' — phrase must match candidate exactly
manual_approval_checkpoint.approval_does_NOT_trigger_execution: Even after manual approval, this stage does NOT submit any tx. Execution is a separate, later, isolated stage (NOT yet specified).

dry_run_builder_allowed_operations: eth_getCode (pool, token, position manager, swap router)
eth_call (any read-only — slot0, liquidity, fee, ticks, balanceOf, allowance, QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle, simulate calldata via eth_call with from=wallet)
eth_getLogs (bounded, for fee velocity / NFT Transfer history)
eth_estimateGas (read-only gas estimate; does NOT send)
construct calldata locally (encode ABI without signing)
dry_run_builder_forbidden_operations: load private key from disk, env, keystore, or KMS
create or use a wallet client capable of submitting tx
call approve / mint / increaseLiquidity / decreaseLiquidity / collect / burn / swap on any contract
flip can_run_probe_now / tiny_canary_allowed / edge_proven flags anywhere
